name: lw_24699
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (habc : a + b + c = 1) : a + b^2 / c + c + a^2 / b + b + c^2 / a ≥ 4
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (habc : a + b + c = 1), a + b^2 / c + c + a^2 / b + b + c^2 / a ≥ 4
informal: If a,b,c are positive numbers and $a+b+c=1$ then $\sum_{cyc} \frac{a+b^2}{c}\geq 4$
